basic_details.job_title: GMRC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 12 Additional General Manager, Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation (GMRC) Limited, a 50:50 Special Purpose Vehicle of the Government of India and the Government of Gujarat, has invited online applications for 12 Rolling Stock posts from Additional General Manager to Engineer (Jr. Grade) on contract, deputation or post-superannuation basis (Advt. No. GMRCL/HR/RECT/RS/Nov-2026/31). The minimum period is 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance. Pay is in the Revised IDA scale from ₹30000 to ₹260000 depending on the post, and a graduate engineering degree in a listed discipline is required. Apply in the Careers sectio

age_limit.details: Age limit is not applicable to GMRCL employees. Age relaxation does not apply to officials re-employed in GMRCL after superannuation. Eligible officials/staff working in GMRC who have completed minimum two years of service as on 21 November 2026 at present designation and grade may apply through proper channel. Candidates working in Indian Railways, Metro Rail Organization, State or Central Govt. PSU/Board/Organization of Government may apply on deputation basis on the standard terms and conditions of the parent organization. Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in Gujarat State for at least 03 years and are conversant with the Gujarati language. | Prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum requirements; possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of each post.

qualification.details: Graduate engineering in Electrical / Mechanical / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Power Electronics / Instrumentation or equivalent discipline from a Govt. recognized University/Institute.

content_sections.heading: About GMRC
content_sections.text: Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation (GMRC) Limited is a 50:50 Special Purpose Vehicle jointly owned by the Government of India and the Government of Gujarat. The notice says it is entrusted with implementing the Ahmedabad Metro Rail Project and the Surat Metro Rail Project and with their Operations & Maintenance. The posts here are in Rolling Stock for these two projects. This is a recruitment by a company (SPV), not a regular government department post.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 12 vacancies in total across six posts. It says the number of posts may vary based on further assessment of requirements. The notice prints one combined figure of 5 for the Engineer – Sr. Grade and Engineer – Jr. Grade posts and does not split it between the two grades. It does not print a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Graduate engineering in Electrical / Mechanical / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Power Electronics / Instrumentation or equivalent discipline from a Govt. recognized University/Institute. Candidates should have relevant experience such as planning, preparation of technical specification, administration of contracts, installation, testing, commissioning and statutory approvals of Rolling Stock system in railways/metros/other PSUs/private sector. They should preferably also be experienced with the latest electrical / rolling stock technologies of urban and suburban rail systems. Work experience: applicants from Government organizations, Metro Rail, Railway PSUs or other PSUs must have 15 years of post-qualification executive experience, of which relevant work experience should be 8 years. OR candidates from private industries should have a total of 18 years of executive experience, of which relevant work experience should be 8 years. Maximum age: 53 years for contract; 58 years for deputation basis; 62 years for post-superannuation basis. Pay-scale eligibility (IDA/CDA candidates): working in IDA pay scale of ₹100000-260000, or at least 2 years in the IDA pay scale of ₹90,000-240,000 or above; OR at Pay Matrix Level 13/13A (SAG/NFSAG) or equivalent, or at least 2 years at Level 12 or an equivalent scale under the 7th CPC. Private sector: minimum CTC of ₹2,00,000 per month. Post-superannuation basis: should be presently working or retired from IDA pay scale 100000-260000 or above, OR CDA pay matrix Level-13/13A (7th CPC) or above. Work experience: minimum 16 years of relevant post-qualification experience of Executive Level in a reputed private organization, OR 14 years of relevant post-qualification experience of Executive level in Government / PSU's. Maximum age: 50 years for contract basis; 57 years for deputation; 62 years for post-superannuation basis. Pay-scale eligibility: presently working in IDA pay scale of ₹90000-240000 or higher pay scales or equivalent CDA pay scale; OR at least 2 years' experience in IDA pay scale of ₹80000-220000 or higher pay scales or equivalent CDA pay scale. Private sector: minimum CTC of ₹1,50,000 per month. Work experience: minimum 15 years of relevant post-qualification experience of executive level in reputed private organization, OR 11 years of relevant post-qualification experience of executive level in Government / PSU's. Maximum age: 48 years for contract basis; 57 years for deputation; 62 years for post-superannuation basis. Pay-scale eligibility: presently working in IDA pay scale of ₹80000-220000 or higher pay scales, OR Pay Level 11 or equivalent CDA pay scale under the 7th CPC; OR at least 2 years' experience in IDA pay scale of ₹70000-₹200000, OR in pay Level 10 or equivalent CDA pay scale under the 7th CPC. Post-superannuation basis: presently working or retired from IDA pay scale ₹80000-220000 or above, OR in Pay Level 11 or equivalent CDA pay scale under the 7th CPC. Priv

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The posts are offered on contract, deputation or post-superannuation basis for a minimum period of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance, subject to the standard terms and conditions of the organization. Apart from the pay, other benefits are paid as per the Company Policy. Selected candidates will be given Group medical coverage and Group personal accident insurance as per the governing policies of GMRCL. For IDA/CDA scale employees, the percentage of HRA may vary according to the place of posting as per Government guidelines and company policy.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications are accepted, and no other means or mode of application is accepted. Applicants should first check their age, educational qualifications, experience and other requirements. Go to the "Careers" section of the website http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com . Register on the portal using basic details such as name, date of birth, category, mobile number and email ID. Log in with the credentials; the passcode is sent to the email ID given at registration. Select the position for which you are applying. Fill in the online application with relevant details, from latest to earliest, and complete the application form. Check the entered details using the "preview" option, then submit the form after verifying all the information. Submit the application by 5 December 2026. The details can be edited before submission, but once the form is submitted it cannot be edited. Detailed curriculum vitae. Proof of age: Matriculation/Birth Certificate. Educational qualification: SSC marksheet/HSC marksheets/Graduation all year/semester marksheets and degree/diploma certificates. Experience: experience/service certificates of past employments showing date of joining, date of relieving and department worked, together with pay details clearly mentioning payscale/CTC. Candidates from private organizations: copy of the latest CTC breakup, submitted at the time of online application. Without the CTC breakup, the application will not be considered for the position applied. Form-16 is considered for arriving at the current CTC. Details of current organization: appointment letter, proof of date of joining, latest payslip, Form-16 of last three years etc.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises Personal Interviews followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination, as per the category prescribed for the post. It would judge different facets of knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude and physical fitness. Call letters for interview are issued to shortlisted applicants through registered email, with the time, date and venue. The venue, date and time of the interview will be informed in advance. Any request for a change in date or venue will not be entertained. Document verification is done before the interview. Candidates must carry their original certificates, failing which they will not be allowed to attend the interview. Preference is given to candidates with experience in the same grade or the immediate lower grade with 2 years' experience in the grade. If enough suitable candidates are not available for a post, candidates from a lower pay scale who meet the prescribed qualifications, total experience and age criteria may be considered.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies in Rolling Stock: Additional General Manager 1, Joint General Manager 1, Sr. Deputy General Manager 1, Manager 3, Asst. Manager 1, and Engineer – Sr. Grade / Jr. Grade 5. The notice says the number of posts may vary.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for GMRC Rolling Stock posts?
faq.answer: All six posts require graduate engineering in Electrical / Mechanical / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Power Electronics / Instrumentation or equivalent discipline from a Govt. recognized University/Institute, plus post-specific experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age on contract basis is 53 years (Additional General Manager), 50 (Joint General Manager), 48 (Sr. Deputy General Manager), 40 (Manager), 35 (Asst. Manager) and 32 (Engineer posts). Age is reckoned as on 21 November 2026. The limits are higher for deputation and post-superannuation basis on the three senior posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for GMRC Rolling Stock posts?
faq.answer: Pay is in the Revised IDA scale: ₹100000-260000 for Additional General Manager, ₹90000-240000 for Joint General Manager, ₹80000-220000 for Sr. Deputy General Manager, ₹60000-180000 for Manager, ₹50000-160000 for Asst. Manager, ₹35000-110000 for Engineer – Sr. Grade and ₹30000-120000 for Engineer – Jr. Grade.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the "Careers" section of http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com. Only online applications are accepted. Register, log in, select the position, fill in the form, preview it and submit before 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection comprises Personal Interviews followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination, as per the category prescribed for the post. Shortlisted applicants receive call letters with the date, time and venue by registered email.

faq.question: Q8. Is the GMRC Rolling Stock job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The posts are offered on contract, deputation or post-superannuation basis for a minimum period of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance, subject to the organization's standard terms and conditions.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired employees apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Retired or serving officers may apply on post-superannuation basis for Additional General Manager, Joint General Manager and Sr. Deputy General Manager, with a maximum age of 62 years. Consolidated pay is ₹1,45,000 per month for the first two posts and ₹1,00,000 per month for Sr. Deputy General Manager.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any preference for Gujarat candidates?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in Gujarat State for at least 03 years and are conversant with the Gujarati language.
